children.text: Participants
Thinkbyte: Krishna Sindhur, vinay kovvuri, Yash Mori, Anupam Gevariya, Sujan Deta, Vamsi Posimsetti
Key Takeaways

The meeting was about progressing the development of a video streaming project, with Anupam Gevariya and Yash Mori assigned specific technical tasks related to system fixes and the recommendation model, respectively

A major concern addressed was Anupam Gevariya's system issues, which were affecting his ability to work efficiently, particularly on the Hubspot demo, and he was tasked with decrypting his disk and seeking help from a colleague

Yash Mori was given the responsibility to generate stimulation scores for the recommendation model and to research document classifiers, important components for the project's content recommendation and document management features

There was a consensus on the need for an architecture diagram for the video streaming project, which is to be completed and submitted by 10 PM, indicating a tight deadline and focus on the project's technical planning

The meeting covered the need for detailed research and decisions on the technologies to be used for various system components, including the content management system and user management system, yet specific solutions were not finalized during the discussion
Recently Completed Tasks
Yash Mori completed the NVIDIA task condition.
Anupam Gevariya is tasked with resolving system issues impeding his work on the Hubspot demo.
A key agenda item was to create and submit an architecture diagram for a video streaming project by 10 PM.
The team discussed progress on tasks such as Yash Mori's recommendation model and document classifier research.
Activity Stimulation Scores
The team needs to define these activity attributes and decide how to quantify their stimulation levels for different cognitive functions.
Vinay discusses the need to assign stimulation scores between zero to one for various attributes of activities, which will be used in the recommendation model.
Current Tasks
Yash Mori is assessing document classifiers and generating scores for the recommendation model.
Anupam Gevariya is resolving system issues and preparing for the Hubspot demo.
Insurance Password Issue
Yash is dealing with an unidentified issue concerning an insurance password, indicating a need for further troubleshooting or research.
The problem seems to be related to documentation or a lack of it, hindering progress.
Decision
Yash Mori is assigned to research document classifiers and generate scores for activities for the recommendation model.
The team is to develop an architecture diagram for the video streaming project and submit it by 10 PM.
Document Classifier
Yash is tasked with researching tools and libraries for a document classification feature, specifically looking into OCR technology.
The discussion reveals that Yash needs to generate a list of technologies and a comparison table to assess their efficiency, cost, and suitability for the project.
The team agrees to compile this information for further discussion, but there is no concrete resolution on which technology to use by the end of the meeting.
Developer System Fixes
Anupam and Krishna discuss the need to address system issues, such as dual boot and decryption problems, to facilitate development work.
There are plans to pair up and resolve the system issues, but at the meeting's end, these problems remain unresolved.
Anupam plans to resolve his system issues and seek assistance from colleagues who have faced similar problems.
Learning and Development
This is not a problem but a development opportunity; Krishna provides resources and advice for self-improvement.
Krishna encourages the team to learn about various technologies and suggests looking at open-source projects like Superset and Temporal for code examples and best practices.
The team is encouraged to spend time on personal development, learning from existing large-scale projects, and engaging with the community.
HubSpot Integration
By the end of the meeting, Anupam has sorted out the immediate issues but plans to work on system fixes and further HubSpot integration tasks post-meeting.
Anupam is working on integrating HubSpot and demonstrates updating contact information but faces difficulties running the code on his Windows machine due to BitLocker encryption issues.
Issues with system compatibility and the need to decrypt the disk to proceed with dual boot and other technical tasks are discussed.
Concerns
Anupam Gevariya is experiencing system issues which are hindering his work efficiency.
Workload and Study Balance
Anupam mentions his college commitments and the challenge of balancing them with work and research.
The team members express their aspirations and plans for the future, with an emphasis on learning and applying their skills to their respective domains.
Vamsi discusses his intention to complete his thesis and join the company in Bangalore full-time.
Content Management System
A content management system (CMS) is mentioned as a critical component of the streaming service for managing movies, metadata, and policies.
The CMS would handle promotional campaigns for movies and control what content is visible to users based on geolocation and other rules.
Video Processing
The discussion revolves around the complexity of video processing for a streaming platform, including handling different file types, DRM checks, and breaking videos into chunks for streaming.
By the end of the meeting, the team seems to have a broad understanding of the video processing requirements but will need to delve deeper into the specifics and architecture.

Vinay and Krishna elaborate on the need for encryption, storage on the cloud, and various microservices required for authentication, catalog services, recommendations, user management, and business policies.
System Architecture
There's a focus on creating a detailed architecture diagram for the client, with an emphasis on the ingestion and service layers of the video streaming platform.
Sujan, Vamsi, and Anupam are tasked with understanding the components required, such as kafka, S3 storage, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, and CDNs.

The architecture is still in the planning phase, with a need to research and decide on the technologies and strategies to be used; a follow-up meeting is scheduled to further discuss the architecture.
Business Goals
Complete and submit the architecture diagram for the video streaming project by 10 PM.
Recommendation Engine
The current state of the recommendation engine is in the conceptual phase, with further development required.
There is mention of the need to integrate user behavior and preferences into the recommendation system.
The team needs to work on a recommendation engine as part of the streaming service, which will suggest content based on various factors.
User Management System
User management is discussed, including subscriptions, payment flows, and in-app purchases, as well as the handling of free versus paid content.
The system would need to consider user geography for content access and manage user profiles and viewing rights.
Follow-up Meeting
The Hubspot meeting is rescheduled to Monday, with a demo expected to be presented.
